summary: Completed mobile responsiveness testing for BluBridge Home page. All reported issues have been fixed and verified across 3 viewports (375px mobile, 768px tablet, 1920px desktop).
critical_code_review_comments: CSS transform scaling approach for orbit container is well-implemented with proper breakpoints
Grid layout change from 'grid-cols-2' to 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' correctly handles mobile stacking
Negative margins on orbit container (-120px mobile, -70px tablet) help center the scaled element properly
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness fixes verified. The orbit animation uses CSS transform scaling at different breakpoints (0.50 for mobile, 0.73 for tablet, 1.0 for desktop). Industry cards use responsive grid classes for proper stacking.
